text: The purpose of this report is to advise on the results of the Negotiated Request for Proposal Doc5179720264, issued in July 2025, for the provision of Heating, Ventilation, and Air Conditioning maintenance and repair services at various City of Toronto locations, and to request authority for the Executive Director, Corporate Real Estate Management and Chief Procurement Officer, to award contracts for a five-year term, to the following top-ranked suppliers, as identified through the Negotiated Request for Proposal: - Ainsworth Inc., in the amount of $36,299,091 net of all applicable taxes and charges ($36,937,956 net of Harmonized Sales Tax recoveries); and - Standard Mechanical Systems Limited in the amount of $40,690,499 net of all applicable taxes and charges ($41,406,652 net of Harmonized Sales Tax recoveries).
